observations.evidence: The Operations Group page explicitly invites applicants to join the group as PhD students. This is direct doctoral recruitment, rather than only a faculty research-interest description.

Three chairs are Mathematics for Business and Economics, Quantitative Business Administration, and Sustainable Operations Management. The group explicitly says its chairs collaborate in PhD supervision.

The Operations Group explicitly belongs to the Department of Business Administration at the University of Zurich. The group describes Operations Management research; it is a group, not a standalone department.

The Graduate School of Business offers Business Administration and Management and Economics doctoral programmes. Four structured fields are Accounting/Auditing/Corporate Governance; Marketing; Personnel/Leadership/Education; Strategy/Organization/Innovation. The Operations recruitment page does not allocate its students to one exact award or track.

Current five Informatics doctoral fields are Information Systems, Software Systems, People-Oriented Computing, Artificial Intelligence and Data Science. No matching title found in this complete named menu.

Science lists seven graduate schools, including Mathematics, Computational Science/Astrophysics/Cosmology and Data Science. It explicitly describes original independent research leading to Dr. sc. nat.; this credential is not assigned to the business group.
The mathematics doctoral school is jointly organized by ETH Mathematics and UZH Mathematics. Joint school membership does not establish that every research topic is available for both institutions.

The joint graduate faculty research inventory includes Operation Research, among other topics. The page points separately to ETH and UZH research. UZH-specific allocation remains unresolved; no ETH award or field is assigned to UZH.
The linked UZH page renders the institute homepage and confirms cooperation with ETH for the mathematics doctoral programme; it does not expose the promised specific UZH research inventory.

Astrophysics offers Computational Science and Theoretical Astrophysics and Cosmology PhD programmes. It explicitly requires UZH enrolment, a doctoral agreement, research supervision and thesis defence. Exact Computational Science named fields remain to be inspected.

limitations: No qualifying programme is proposed yet: exact business award/doctoral recruitment linkage awaits integrator adjudication. Do not invent an Operations Research degree or formal concentration.
